# golden/: RHEF conformance bundle (generated by tools/make_golden.py; never edit by hand)

One folder per case: raw little-endian C-order arrays (input, radii, edges, bin_index, expected_<convention>) and case.properties.
Expected outputs: orhef.orhef (oRHEF-2.0) and sunkit_image.radial.rhef 0.7.0 (sunkit-0.7); .f32 files are the .f64 values rounded.
Read with read_golden.py (stdlib only); copy into a consumer repo with tools/sync_golden.sh; check with make check.
RHEF output is a visualization, not a calibrated radiance.
